title: Bangladesh challenges ousted PM Hasina over return pledge
paragraphs: Bangladesh challenges ousted PM Hasina over return pledge

Hasina, whose 15-year rule was ended by a mass uprising she tried to crush, has vowed to return in December to Bangladesh, where she was sentenced to death for crimes against humanity over the 2024 crackdown on protesters.

DHAKA: Bangladesh on Monday (Nov 9) challenged ousted leader Sheikh Hasina to seek extradition from India if she was serious about returning home, while reviewing an application to renew her passport.
